name: Shinrei Kenkyuukai
source:
I happened to listen to Senpai's ghost story in "Spirit Research Club."
She told me four stories about ghost. I was a chicken, so I left the room like a coward.
Then, the next day, that incident happened.

Four ghost stories, and what awaits at the end of these stories...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ046271.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我偶然在“灵研究社”听了前辈的鬼故事。
她给我讲了四个关于鬼的故事。我是一只胆小鬼，所以我像个胆小鬼一样离开了房间。
然后，第二天，那件事就发生了。

四个鬼故事，以及这些故事的结尾等待着什么……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ046271.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
